cases.prompt: Search approval in the supplied knowledge. Explain what binds an approval to an operation. Return a JSON CitedReport with exact quotes and [[full_chunk_id]] markers. State the rule explicitly using the phrase exact tool name and arguments.

documents.title: Approval policy
documents.text: Approval is bound to the exact tool name and arguments. Saving approval does not execute a tool. Execution requires a separate resume.

cases.prompt: Search recovery in the supplied knowledge. Summarize interrupted write recovery in a JSON CitedReport. Include exact supporting quotes and [[full_chunk_id]] markers. Explicitly state that interrupted non-idempotent writes require reconciliation.

documents.title: Recovery policy
documents.text: Interrupted non-idempotent writes require reconciliation. Confirm the original operation's external outcome before deciding how to continue. Do not silently repeat the write.

cases.prompt: Search approval recovery and explain both the approval and recovery policies. Return a JSON CitedReport citing BOTH supplied documents using exact quotes and [[full_chunk_id]] markers. Do not rely on general knowledge.

documents.title: Approval
documents.text: Approval authorizes the exact tool name and arguments. Approval must precede the external write.

documents.title: Recovery
documents.text: Recovery preserves uncertainty after an interrupted external write. Reconcile the original result instead of silently repeating it.
